role: Runbook for GDPR/CCPA deletion and access requests: explains there is no backend, directs users to the in-app Delete All My Data flow (local + CloudKit zone deletion) and Export Data, and gives a reply template.

units.does: no behavioural claim: legal response windows (GDPR 30 days, CCPA 45+45) and HIPAA non-applicability.

units.key: § Runbook: GDPR / CCPA Data-Deletion Request > Architecture you're working with
units.does: Claims: no backend; CloudKit private DB holds session backups, raw RR archives and workout tracks; iCloud sign-out does not delete; Delete All My Data removes the cloud copy; AI API keys are ThisDeviceOnly; archive encryption key is not synchronizable; CloudPayloadCodec key and EntitlementAnchor are synchronizable. Verified: APIKeyStore uses kSecAttrAccessibleAfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly (APIKeyStore.swift:65), EncryptionManager uses AfterFirstUnlock without synchronizable (EncryptionManager.swift:252), CloudPayloadCodec.swift:281 and EntitlementAnchor.swift:355 set kSecAttrSynchronizable true; workout GPS tracks travel inside the HRVSession payload (CloudKitSyncManager+Push.swift:429).

units.key: § Runbook: GDPR / CCPA Data-Deletion Request > Step 1 — Understand what you can and cannot do
units.does: Claims no account system, so nothing to verify; the Profile email field is a report recipient. No code contradiction found.

units.key: § Runbook: GDPR / CCPA Data-Deletion Request > Step 2 — Local data deletion
units.does: Claims More → Settings → Advanced Data Controls → Delete All My Data, typing DELETE MY DATA, calls DataPurgeService.purgeAllUserData which wipes archive, raw backups, CloudKit sync state, API keys, conversations, user facts, disclaimer flags, debug/crash logs, units preference, breadcrumbs, legacy widget keys and sweeps containers/preferences with a keep-list; keeps Health samples and the purchase/trial anchor. Verified: confirmPhrase 'DELETE MY DATA' (DeleteAllDataPage.swift:28); Report fields and steps (DataPurgeService.swift:183-212, 553-577); defaultsKeepList keeps entitlement.anchor.v1 and storekit.lastKnown* (DataPurgeService.swift:331-335); keepList keeps user_settings.json, reset via resetToDefaults.

units.key: § Runbook: GDPR / CCPA Data-Deletion Request > Step 3 — CloudKit private-DB deletion
units.does: Claims the purge awaits CloudKitSyncManager.deleteAllRemoteData, which deletes zones HRVSessions and UserSettings before the local wipe; offline/signed-out failure still completes the local wipe and reports remoteDeleted false, surfaced as a retry prompt; re-running is idempotent. Verified: purgeRemote runs first (DataPurgeService.swift:190), allCustomZoneIDs (CloudKitSyncManager+Deletion.swift:18-23), zone-already-gone counts as success, 30 s timeout, remoteLine 'NOT deleted — run this again…' (DataPurgeService.swift:69-75).

units.key: § Runbook: GDPR / CCPA Data-Deletion Request > Step 4 — Third-party AI provider data
units.does: Claims providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, DeepSeek) retain content and the user enabled them per ProviderConsentTracker's consent log. Provider files exist (AnthropicProvider, OpenAIProvider, GeminiProvider, GrokProvider, DeepSeekProvider).

flags.text: Runbook tells the operator to cite the ProviderConsentTracker consent log, but the purge's preferences sweep removes every non-kept UserDefaults key, so after Delete All My Data no consent record remains to cite.

units.key: § Runbook: GDPR / CCPA Data-Deletion Request > Step 5 — Data export (Article 15 / 20)
units.does: Claims More → Settings → iCloud & Data → Import & Export → Export Data offers RR CSV, summary CSV and all-sessions JSON. Verified: SettingsPages+Data.swift:232/252 Import & Export → ExportDataView with 'Export RR Intervals (CSV)', 'Export Summary (CSV)', 'Export All Sessions (JSON)' (ExportAndArchiveViews.swift:121-138).

units.key: § Runbook: GDPR / CCPA Data-Deletion Request > Step 6 — Reply template
units.does: Reply template repeating the in-app deletion steps, the iCloud sign-out warning and the export path; consistent with Step 2/3/5 claims.

units.key: § Runbook: GDPR / CCPA Data-Deletion Request > Step 7 — Log the request
units.does: no behavioural claim: keep a private log outside the repo for 3 years.

units.key: § Runbook: GDPR / CCPA Data-Deletion Request > Edge cases
units.does: no behavioural claim: guidance for account-takeover suspicion, minors, deceased users.

units.key: § Runbook: GDPR / CCPA Data-Deletion Request > Compliance posture (for your records)
units.does: Claims nothing health-related remains in the app after delete-all; Apple Health samples remain. Consistent with DataPurgeService sweep design and footerLines note.
